summary: References a material from elsewhere in the project while exposing common MAT render-state pages such as deform, blending, depth test, alpha test, wireframe, cull face, and polygon offset.

key_params.name: dodeform
key_params.note: Enable deform handling on the selected material wrapper

key_concepts: Select MAT gets a material from another location in the project using the Select MAT path parameter.
It is best used around stable Null MAT endpoints or explicit component material outputs so material internals can change without breaking references.
The selected material path must resolve at cook time, which makes relative versus absolute path strategy important in reusable components.
Select MAT exposes deform and common MAT render-state pages, so it can still modify depth, blending, culling, and deformation behavior around the selected material.
For skinned geometry, deform settings on the Select MAT wrapper must remain compatible with the selected material and geometry capture data.
common_gotchas: The selected MAT path must resolve at cook time; use stable Null/Select-style references around reusable materials.
Common MAT states on the Select MAT can still affect rendering; do not assume it is a pure pointer.
For deformed geometry, make sure deform data settings match the selected material and geometry capture data.
